about_the_game:
Squars – Strategic Defense in a World of Squares!

Square up in Squars! – a unique Tower Defense game where everything, from towers to enemies, is square! Survive endless waves of enemies, expand your base, and experiment with powerful tower and skill combinations.

Key Features:

  • Strategic Defense – Build and upgrade a variety of towers, each with unique effects and abilities.

  • Roguelike Twist – Choose from random upgrade cards at certain stages, influencing your strategy and playstyle.

  • Dynamic Enemy Waves – Each new wave brings fresh challenges! The longer you play, the tougher the enemies become.

  • Tactical Abilities – Activate special skills to help you survive critical moments.

  • Minimalist yet Stylish Design – A clean and readable aesthetic in a world full of geometric challenges.

  • Endless Possibilities – Test different combinations of towers, upgrades, and strategies to find the best way to survive!

Do you have what it takes to defend your base and discover the most powerful combinations? Play Squars and see how long you can last in a world full of square chaos!
